description: This file contains C source code implementing utilities for download management within a Remote Device Management (RDM) system. It includes functions for URL handling, file operations, certificate management, download execution (including direct and application downloads), JSON parsing, and app lifecycle management such as cleanup, validation, and uninstalling apps. The code also interacts with system utilities, network protocols, and cryptography for secure signature verification.

classes.name: FileDwnl_t
classes.description: Structure to hold details about a file download, including URL, path, SSL verification, and post data.

classes.name: MtlsAuth_t
classes.description: Structure holding TLS certificate information such as cert name, type, and password.

classes.description: Structure used to manage memory and data associated with a file download operation.
